kdf_note: All slots use KdfPreset::Fast (Argon2id m=8 MiB, t=1, p=1) for test speed, except nudo.nvault which uses KdfPreset::Strong as calibrated on the generating machine (p = 4, like real volumes).

volumes.description: Everything this build writes: files of several sizes (empty, small, exactly one chunk, 3-chunk odd size, overwritten + truncated), nested folders, unicode / NFD / space / dot names, a renamed+moved file, a deleted file and folder, fixed mtimes; image emblem visible (256 px inside, 128 px copy in the header), accent velluto, theme light, auto-lock 5 min / no lock on sleep / scope all; slots password(labelled), password(unicode pw, labelled), hole, recipient (archivio.nvkey), duress; 4 password-manager entries with TOTP (SHA1/SHA256-8-60), hidden field, history (2 from updates, 2 imported), one deleted entry.

Appearance ENCRYPTED (no header section): icon emblem 'key' + accent prussia live only inside; theme system, auto-lock never, no lock on screen lock; one labelled password slot; one PM entry (TOTP SHA512-7-45).

Simulated pre-velluto volume: settings JSON {auto_lock_minutes:30, accent:bordeaux} with no theme / lock fields, header section accent 'bordeaux' + Initial B. Must read as velluto, theme dark, other fields defaulted.
nv-core only (no app meta keys, no header appearance section), KdfPreset::STRONG (the real-volume Argon2id parameters, p = 4), one unlabelled slot, one file.
